budget_1_2_star.sourceTitle: Hotel Data for Researchers & Academics — HOTEVI
budget_1_2_star.evidenceText: HOTEVI's sample table identifies average nightly rates in USD by star tier and lists Hanoi, Vietnam with Budget $30.
budget_1_2_star.referencePeriod: Monthly average; HOTEVI research page cites HOTEVI Hotel Price Index retrieved July 30, 2026; research page does not specify a calendar index month.
budget_1_2_star.reason: Grouped 1-2-star source-defined standard-room proxy; not an observed individual product star value.
